[{"node":"menu_content109","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Reservations Setup","key":"docs_reservations_setup_menu_content","id":"docs_reservations_setup_menu_content","name":"docs_reservations_setup_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Reservations setup","key":"md_reservations_setup","id":"reservations-setup","name":"md_reservations_setup","value":"# Reservations setup

Reservations, the waitlist and seating are run from the [host stand](/Docs/Host%20Stand) on the POS. Their rules live in **Reservation Settings**, one record per restaurant (**Restaurant workspace → Reservation Settings**)."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Booking rules","key":"md_booking_rules","id":"booking-rules","name":"md_booking_rules","value":"# Booking rules

- **Restaurant** and **Take Reservations**.
- **Largest Party**: bigger groups must be arranged by a manager (0 = no limit).
- **Minimum Notice** (minutes) and **Book Up To** (days ahead)."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Table times","key":"md_table_times","id":"table-times","name":"md_table_times","value":"# Table times

- **Default Table Time**: how long a party keeps the table.
- **Table Time by Party Size**: different times by size (2 guests 75 min, 6 guests 120 min).

Table times decide when a table is free again, so the same table can be booked several times a night."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Arrival","key":"md_arrival","id":"arrival","name":"md_arrival","value":"# Arrival

- **Late Arrival Grace**: after this, the reservation shows as late on the host stand.
- **No Show After**: reservations not seated this long after their time become *No Show* by themselves (0 = never).
- **Hold Table Before**: from this long before the reservation, its table shows as *Reserved* on the floor plan, so nobody seats walk-ins there."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Slots and pacing","key":"md_slots_and_pacing","id":"slots-and-pacing","name":"md_slots_and_pacing","value":"# Slots and pacing

- **Slot Every**: the times offered (every 15 minutes…).
- **Max Guests per Slot**: how many guests may arrive at the same time, to pace the kitchen (0 = no limit).
- **Reservation Hours**: when reservations can start; empty accepts any time."}},{"node":"markdown106","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Guest messages","key":"md_guest_messages","id":"guest-messages","name":"md_guest_messages","value":"# Guest messages

- **Email Confirmation** and **Email Reminder** (with how many hours before), each with an Email Template.
- **Send SMS too**: uses the site's SMS Settings for confirmations, reminders and the waitlist.
- **Table Ready Message**: the text sent to someone on the waitlist when their table is ready."}},{"node":"markdown107","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Online booking","key":"md_online_booking","id":"online-booking","name":"md_online_booking","value":"# Online booking

- **Accept Online Reservations**: guests book on `/reserve` (the Desk has it under **Online Booking Page**). A table that fits the party is assigned automatically.
- **Largest Party Online** and **Note for Guests** (cancellation policy, parking)."}},{"node":"markdown108","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Who uses it","key":"md_who_uses_it","id":"who-uses-it","name":"md_who_uses_it","value":"# Who uses it

People whose role has **Manage reservations and waitlist** (Host, Server, Manager) see the reservations button on the floor plan. See [Host stand](/Docs/Host%20Stand)."}}]}]
